We need to find template that when applied retrosynthetically reproduces the Doebner modification: aromatic aldehyde + malonic acid -> alpha,beta-unsaturated carboxylic acid (with decarboxylation). The target molecule given in previous step: from make_7_lvl2-apply_template-1 answer: precursors list: ['CC(C)(C)OC(=O)Nc1ccccc1N', 'Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(C=CC(=O)O)cc2)cc1']

So the target molecule is: CC(C)(C)OC(=O)Nc1ccccc1NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(C=CC(=O)O)cc2

We need to find template that when applied to this molecule gives those two precursors (or at least matches). The template search criteria: functional groups formed: C-C double bond (the forward reaction forms double bond). Also bonds formed/broken? The description: carbon-carbon double bond formed, carbon-carbon bond broken, carbon-oxygen bond broken. So we could filter by bonds formed/broken. But we need template ID and mapped_rxn.

We need to search template catalog with criteria: functional_groups_formed includes "C-C double bonds". Also maybe bonds_formed: "6-6"? Not sure. Let's try search with functional_groups_formed "C-C double bonds".
